**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `ymdA`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99% of them, at 0.44 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns**, 1 to 79, carried by 39 to 89%, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 69% of calls. The `csg` genes, columns 1 to 7, are [[curli assembly and transport]], and the `rut` genes, columns 26 to 33, are [[pyrimidine utilization]]. A branch of 55 families runs through columns 1 to 55 in 10 to 11%, `ymdB` to `ptsG`.

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 99 against 92%, and hesitates less there, 0.44 against 0.52 bits. It hesitates most at column 12, `ycdU`, a fork column, 2.22 bits.

**The window ends on fork columns.** Column 79, `yccS`, is carried by 45% of chromosomes. A branch of 4 families runs through columns 76 to 79 in 21 to 28%, `ompA` to `fabA`.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.52 bits on average, perplexity 1.6 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.45 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 75% against 97%.

label: ymdA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ymdA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ymdA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,648 to 2,727 from dnaA. Read in 518 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ymdA once); 41,440 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.52 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 30,583 calls, named 99%, 0.18 bits; shell 10,130 calls, named 76%, 1.28 bits; cloud 727 calls, named 27%, 4.16 bits. Outside an RGP 31,042 calls, named 97%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 10,398 calls, named 75%, 1.45 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 76 fork, 3 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.45 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 97%); 10,398 of the 41,440 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 12 (ycdU, a fork column) 2.22 bits, RGP 65%; column 13 ("IS3-like element IS3 family transposase", a fork column) 1.36 bits, RGP 69%; column 31 (rutE, a fork column) 0.77 bits, RGP 23%. The 11 columns (columns 12-17 and 51-55) where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.80 bits on average; the other 69 columns: named 93%, 0.47 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99%, 0.44 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 92%, 0.52 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 12, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ymdA "protein YmdA". named 99%; 0.44 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 39-89%, 63 P, 16 S, RGP 0.2-69%. named 57-99.6% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 12, named 57%, 2.22 bits.
